title: 걷기 · 조깅
intro: '걷기·조깅'은 조깅 장소 묘사 → 조깅 루틴 → 처음 시작한 계기 → 예전과 지금의 변화 비교 순서로 자주 출제됩니다. 페르소나는 분당에서 가족과 함께 사는 20년차 개발팀 리드로, 일주일에 세 번 아침 6시 반에 아파트에서 걸어서 5분 거리인 탄천 산책로를 30분씩 뜁니다. '탄천 산책로'와 '4년 전 건강검진 후 동료 Minho와 시작' 이야기 하나만 정해 두면 네 문제 모두 같은 스토리로 연결됩니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it.) → 기본 정보(어디서·얼마나 자주) → 세부(코스·준비·뛴 후) → 느낌·이유(출근 전 머리 식히기, 건강) → 마무리 문장(So yeah, that's pretty much my jogging routine.)
장소는 항상 '아파트에서 걸어서 5분 거리의 탄천 산책로' 하나로 고정하세요. 넓고 평평한 길, 옆을 흐르는 개울, 나무와 벚꽃 같은 쉬운 묘사 3개면 충분합니다.
루틴은 6시 기상 → 물 한 잔·옷 갈아입기 → 5분 스트레칭 → 탄천 30분 조깅 → 집에서 샤워 → 가족과 아침 식사 순서로 시간 흐름을 따라가면 막히지 않습니다.
경험·비교 질문은 '4년 전 큰 프로젝트로 하루 종일 앉아 있다가 건강검진에서 혈압 경고 → Minho와 첫 조깅, 10분 만에 숨이 참 → 1년 뒤 10K 완주 → 지금은 30분 거뜬' 이야기 하나로 둘 다 답할 수 있습니다.

expressions.en: Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it.
expressions.note: 주제 시작 문장: 질문 키워드를 한 번 되묻고 시작

expressions.en: I go jogging about three times a week.
expressions.ko: 저는 일주일에 세 번 정도 조깅해요.
expressions.note: go + -ing: 운동·여가 활동 / 빈도는 문장 끝에

expressions.en: I usually jog along the Tancheon trail.
expressions.ko: 저는 보통 탄천 산책로를 따라 조깅해요.

expressions.en: It's only a five-minute walk from my apartment.
expressions.note: five-minute는 형용사라 minute에 s를 붙이지 않아요

expressions.en: I always stretch before I go out.
I was out of breath after just ten minutes.
I feel much healthier than before.
The path is wide and flat, so it's easy on my knees.
expressions.ko: 길이 넓고 평평해서 무릎에 부담이 없어요.
expressions.note: be easy on ~: ~에 무리가 덜 가다

expressions.en: My doctor told me I needed more exercise.
expressions.ko: 의사가 운동을 더 해야 한다고 했어요.
expressions.note: told me (that) + 과거 시제: 간접화법 시제 일치

expressions.en: My smartwatch keeps track of my distance and heart rate.
Little by little, I got better.
It really helps me clear my head before a busy day.
expressions.ko: 바쁜 하루 전에 머리를 맑게 하는 데 정말 도움이 돼요.
expressions.note: help + 사람 + 동사원형 / clear my head: 머리를 식히다

expressions.en: I try to get out of bed before I can talk myself out of it.
expressions.ko: 안 나갈 핑계를 만들기 전에 얼른 침대에서 일어나려고 해요.
expressions.note: talk oneself out of ~: 스스로 설득해서 ~을 그만두다

expressions.en: Ever since then, I've been hooked.
expressions.note: be hooked: ~에 푹 빠지다 / ever since then + 현재완료

expressions.en: So yeah, that's pretty much my jogging routine.
expressions.ko: 네, 제 조깅 루틴은 대충 이래요.
expressions.note: 마무리 문장: So yeah, that's pretty much ~

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you go walking or jogging. Where do you usually go? Describe the place for me in as much detail as possible.
questions.ko: 설문에서 걷기나 조깅을 한다고 하셨네요. 보통 어디로 가나요? 그 장소를 최대한 자세히 묘사해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 장소(탄천 산책로, 아파트에서 걸어서 5분) → 길·개울·나무 묘사 → 좋은 이유(출근 전 머리 식히기) → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
wide, flat, quiet, pretty 같은 쉬운 형용사 3~4개면 충분해요
이른 아침 풍경(fresh air, sunrise)이나 봄 벚꽃을 한 문장 넣으면 장면이 생생해져요

answers.IM3: Oh, jogging? Sure, I'd love to talk about it. There's a nice jogging trail called the Tancheon trail near my place. It's only about five minutes from my apartment in Bundang. The trail is long and flat, and there's a small stream right next to it. There are lots of trees, so it's really pretty, especially in the spring. In the early morning, it's quiet and the air is fresh. I like jogging there because it helps me clear my head before work. Yeah, that's my favorite place to jog.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about where I go jogging. I really enjoy jogging along the Tancheon trail in my free time. My favorite place to jog is the Tancheon trail near my apartment. It's a long path along a stream, and it's only a five-minute walk from my home. It's a peaceful place with a small stream and lots of trees. The path is wide and flat, so it's easy on my knees. In the spring, cherry blossoms line the path, and it looks amazing. I usually go there around six thirty in the morning, so it's pretty quiet. I just see a few people walking their dogs or older people doing exercises. There are also benches and some outdoor exercise machines along the way. Whenever I jog there, I feel calm and ready for a busy day at work. So yeah, that's the place where I go jogging.
answers.AL: Oh, jogging? Let me think. Well, I'm lucky because one of the best jogging spots in the area is right near my home. It's called the Tancheon trail, and it runs along a stream that goes through Bundang. From my apartment, it's only about a five-minute walk, so I really have no excuse not to go. The trail is wide and flat, and it's split into two lanes, one for bikes and one for people walking or jogging. On one side, you can see the stream, and if you're lucky, you might even spot some ducks or a big white heron standing in the water. On the other side, there are tall trees and flower beds. In the spring, the whole path is covered with cherry blossoms, and in the fall, the leaves turn yellow and red. Since I go out at six thirty in the morning, the air is cool and fresh, and it's peaceful, with just a few early birds like me. Honestly, there's nothing better than jogging there while the sun comes up. What I like most about the place is that it feels like it's just for me, before the meetings and messages start. So yeah, that's pretty much my favorite place in the whole neighborhood.

작은 개울이 있고 나무도 많은 평화로운 곳이에요.
길이 넓고 평평해서 무릎에 부담이 덜해요.

한쪽으로는 개울이 보이고, 운이 좋으면 오리나 물속에 서 있는 커다란 백로를 볼 수도 있어요.
다른 쪽에는 키 큰 나무들과 꽃밭이 있어요.

그래서, 네, 거기가 우리 동네 전체에서 제가 제일 좋아하는 곳이에요.

questions.en: Tell me about your typical walking or jogging routine. How often do you go, what do you do before and after, and what do you bring with you?
questions.ko: 평소 걷기나 조깅 루틴에 대해 말해 주세요. 얼마나 자주 가고, 전후에 무엇을 하며, 무엇을 가지고 가나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 빈도·시간(주 3회, 아침 6시 반) → 나가기 전 준비·챙기는 것 → 30분 조깅 → 다녀온 후(샤워, 가족과 아침) → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
First, Then, After that 같은 순서 표현으로 시간 흐름을 따라가세요
챙기는 물건은 phone, earphones, smartwatch, a bottle of water 정도의 쉬운 단어로

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my jogging routine. I go jogging about three times a week. I usually go at six thirty in the morning before work. Before I go out, I always stretch for five minutes. I bring my phone, my earphones, and a small bottle of water. I jog for about thirty minutes on the Tancheon trail. After that, I come home, take a quick shower, and have breakfast with my family. Yeah, that's my usual jogging routine.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about my jogging routine. I go jogging about three times a week, early in the morning, usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday. I wake up at six, drink a glass of water, and put on my running clothes and shoes. Before I go out, I always stretch for five minutes, because my knees aren't as young as they used to be. I take my phone, my earphones, and my smartwatch so I can check my time and heart rate. First, I walk for a few minutes to warm up. Then, I jog along the Tancheon trail for about thirty minutes while listening to some old rock songs. After I get home, I take a quick shower and have breakfast with my family. My kids are usually just getting up when I come back. It's a simple routine, but it really gives me energy for the day. So yeah, that's pretty much my jogging routine.
answers.AL: Oh, my jogging routine? Let me think. Well, it's pretty much the same every time, and I like it that way. I go jogging about three times a week, usually on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday mornings. My alarm goes off at six, and I try to get out of bed before I can talk myself out of it. I drink a glass of water, put on my running gear, and grab my earphones and my smartwatch, which keeps track of my distance and heart rate. Before I head out, I always stretch for about five minutes. In my forties, skipping that is just asking for a sore knee. Once I get to the Tancheon trail, I walk for a few minutes to warm up, and then I jog for about thirty minutes at a comfortable pace. I usually listen to nineties rock, because it keeps me moving. On the way back, I slow down and cool off. When I get home, I take a quick shower, and by then the whole family is up, so we have breakfast together before my son and daughter head off to school. Honestly, jogging is a big part of my life now, and I really feel the difference when I skip it. Yeah, that's my jogging routine in a nutshell.

저는 일주일에 세 번 정도, 이른 아침에 조깅을 하는데, 보통 월요일, 수요일, 토요일에 해요.
6시에 일어나서 물 한 잔 마시고, 운동복이랑 운동화를 신어요.

시간이랑 심박수를 확인할 수 있게 휴대폰, 이어폰, 스마트워치를 챙겨요.

음, 생각해 볼게요.
음, 매번 거의 똑같은데, 저는 그게 좋아요.
저는 일주일에 세 번 정도 조깅을 하는데, 보통 월요일, 수요일, 토요일 아침이에요.
알람이 6시에 울리면, 안 나갈 핑계를 찾기 전에 침대에서 일어나려고 해요.

questions.en: When did you first start walking or jogging? What made you start, and what was it like at the beginning? Tell me the story from start to finish.
questions.ko: 걷기나 조깅을 처음 시작한 건 언제인가요? 왜 시작했고, 처음엔 어땠나요? 처음부터 끝까지 이야기해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제(4년 전) → 계기(앉아만 있는 생활, 건강검진) → 첫날 이야기(10분 만에 숨참, 동료 Minho의 격려) → 결과·느낌 → 'Yeah, that's how ~' 마무리
경험 질문은 과거 시제로 일관되게! 마지막 한두 문장만 현재로 돌아오세요
Minho가 한 말을 직접 인용('Slow is fine.')하면 이야기가 생생해져요

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you how I started jogging. I started jogging about four years ago. At that time, I had a health checkup, and my doctor said I needed more exercise. I was sitting at my desk all day, and my back hurt a lot. So I decided to jog on the Tancheon trail near my apartment. It was really hard when I first started. I was out of breath after just ten minutes. But I kept going, and it got easier. Yeah, that's how I got into jogging.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about how I started jogging. I started jogging about four years ago. Back then, I was busy with a big project, and I sat in front of my computer for more than ten hours a day. Then I had a health checkup, and my doctor told me my blood pressure was a little high. That was a wake-up call. I have a friend named Minho, and we have worked together for a long time. He was already a runner, so he said, 'Why don't you come jogging with me?' The first morning, we went to the Tancheon trail, and I was totally out of breath after ten minutes. I had to stop and walk, and I felt pretty embarrassed. But Minho told me to go slowly, and little by little, I got better. A year later, we ran our first 10K race together. So yeah, that's how my jogging story started.
answers.AL: Oh, how I started jogging? Let me think. Well, it all started about four years ago, during one of the busiest years of my career. My team was working on a huge project, and I was basically glued to my chair for ten or twelve hours a day. Then I had my yearly health checkup, and the doctor said my blood pressure was getting high and I'd better start exercising. Honestly, that scared me, because I have two kids and I want to stay healthy for them. I have a friend named Minho, and we have worked together for over fifteen years. He'd been jogging for a while, so he offered to show me the ropes. The first morning on the Tancheon trail was a disaster. After about ten minutes, I was completely out of breath, my legs felt like stone, and I had to walk the rest of the way. But Minho kept saying, 'Slow is fine. Just don't stop coming.' So I kept going, and every week I could jog a little longer. About a year later, we ran our first 10K race together, and my whole family was there cheering at the finish line. Ever since then, I've been hooked. Yeah, that's how I got into jogging.

questions.en: How has your walking or jogging changed since you first started? Compare what it was like back then with what it is like now.
questions.ko: 처음 시작했을 때와 비교해 걷기나 조깅이 어떻게 변했나요? 그때와 지금을 비교해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 처음(10분도 힘듦, 주 1회, 낡은 운동화) → 지금(30분 거뜬, 주 3회, 러닝화·스마트워치) → 가장 큰 차이(몸과 마음) → 'So yeah, that's how ~' 마무리
I used to ~, but now I ~ 패턴 하나로 비교의 뼈대를 세우세요
AL은 '의무(chore) → 즐거움'처럼 마음가짐의 변화까지 말하면 깊이가 생겨요

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you how my jogging has changed. When I first started, I could only jog for about ten minutes. I got tired really fast, and I walked a lot. Now I can jog for thirty minutes without stopping. I used to jog only once a week, but now I go three times a week. These days, I use a smartwatch to check my time. I feel much healthier than before. Yeah, that's how my jogging has changed.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about how my jogging has changed. When I first started four years ago, I used to get tired after ten minutes, but now I can easily jog for thirty minutes. Back then, I only went once a week, usually on Saturday, and sometimes I skipped it because I was too tired from work. Now I go three times a week, and it's a regular part of my life. My gear has changed, too. In the beginning, I just wore old sneakers and a T-shirt. Now I have proper running shoes and a smartwatch that tracks my distance. The biggest difference is that I feel much healthier now. I sleep better, my back doesn't hurt as much, and I handle stress at work much better. So yeah, jogging has changed a lot for me, in a good way.
answers.AL: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. Well, my jogging has changed a lot since I first started about four years ago. In the beginning, I could barely jog for ten minutes without stopping, and I used to drag myself out of bed only once a week, mostly because Minho kept texting me. Now I go three times a week without anyone pushing me, and thirty minutes feels easy. Last year I even finished a 10K in under an hour, which I never imagined back then. My gear is completely different, too. I started out in an old pair of sneakers and a cotton T-shirt that got soaked with sweat. These days, I've got proper running shoes and a smartwatch that tracks my pace and heart rate, so I can actually see my progress. But the biggest change isn't my speed. It's my mindset. At first, jogging was something my doctor told me to do, so it felt like a chore. Now it's the part of my week that I look forward to the most. I think this change is because of the progress I can actually see. When work gets stressful, I know a run along the stream will help me calm down and think more clearly. Sometimes my son even joins me on Saturdays, which is a nice bonus. So yeah, that's how jogging went from a chore to something I really love.
